title: helianthemum croceum
intro: Helianthemum croceum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
